create_discounting_chain_env: create a DiscountingChain environment instance with an optional mapping_seed parameter
run_discounting_chain_episode: run a DiscountingChain episode by calling reset then step with discrete actions
get_observation_spec: get the observation spec returning a shape (1,2) float32 array for context and time_to_live
get_action_spec: get the action spec returning a discrete array with 5 possible actions
check_optimal_return: check the optimal_return property which returns 1.1 as the maximum achievable reward
